purpose: Integration tests for AC-19001-7 driving rcf verify run --mode deterministic and rcf verify run --help through bin/rcf.js against a local server that counts requests.
title: rcf verify run --out takes a file path: a directory is refused with exit 2 before the run, and --help says file path

testCases.description: rcf verify run --out <existing directory>, with or without a trailing slash, exits 2 with "--out must be a file path, not a directory" before any request reaches the target and writes nothing in the directory
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/out-directory-refused.test.js::AC-19001-7: rcf verify run --url <url> --out <existing directory> (with or without a trailing slash) exits 2 with "--out must be a file path, not a directory" before any request reaches the target and writes nothing in the directory

testCases.description: rcf verify run --help describes --out as a file path and says a directory is refused (exit 2)
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/out-directory-refused.test.js::AC-19001-7: rcf verify run --help describes --out as a file path and says a directory is refused (exit 2)
